caseName: Continental & Commercial Trust & Savings Bank v. Werner
caseNameFull: Continental & Commercial Trust & Savings Bank v. Wilhelmina Werner
summary: Error to the Supreme Court of the State of Idaho.
attorneys: Mr. Edward A. Walters, with whom Mr. Oliver O. Haga and Mr. R. P. Parry were on the brief, for plaintiff in error. Mr. W. C. Bissell, with whom Mr. Wm. W. Ray and Mr. M. F. Ryan were on the brief, for defendants in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for want of jurisdiction upon the authority of Spencer v. Duplan Silk Co., 191 U. S. 526, 530; Shulthis v. McDougal, 225 U. S. 561, 569; Hull v. Burr, 234 U. S. 712, 720; Norton v. Whiteside, 239 U. S. 144, 147. Petition for certiorari denied.
